clauses.clause: Underground readability: player contrast ≥ 3:1; infected eyes brightest pixels.
clauses.note: FAIL strict eyes-brightest clause in both tiers: actual elderly infected62 forehead pixel(772,384), RGB175/125/98, linear luminance0.24663033 exceeds brightest eye0.24487004 low/0.23464440 high (0.719%/5.108%). Forehead9.055px from eye, outside2px eye-edge exclusion. Same-pose native-repeat body pixels all bitwise identical after mask restoration. Courier P90/2m ground-ring contrast passes3:1. Fourteen native/mask captures and exact face closeups personally inspected: red eye islands resolve below brighter tan forehead. This is a strict small numeric failure, not a subjective claim of poor visibility. Controlled existing-actor pose/emergency fixture disclosed; no source edits. Repro: actual second-breach emergency/headlamp tunnel x110/z15, original actor62 nearby facing camera; differential actual instance masks and linear-sRGB comparison.
